Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arun..label: On the Dappled Rose
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arun..startdescription: 'Petals, a friend used to say, are the skin of flowers; and flowers are the hair of a plant. I wonder what it means, this dappled rose? I'd like to look in your collection.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moth> as their <sprite name=moth> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arun..label: On the Forgivable Debt
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arun..startdescription: 'The sages of the Corrivality tell us that understanding leads to conflict. I wonder, then, if peace might arise from confusion?' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arun..label: On the 'Invisible Opera'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arun..startdescription: 'The Opera is dedicated to Ferezeref the Magpie, Name of the Moth. Ferezeref is a trouble-maker - perhaps the paramount trouble-maker. (I suppose I have a certain knack for trouble myself, but I acknowledge the master.) So there will be alarums, excursions, possibly exsanguinations. But from even the most irresponsible phoenix, we can hope to rescue an egg...' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moth> as their <sprite name=moth> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arun..label: On the Rising While
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arun..startdescription: 'How do we know 'now'? By the angle of the sun. Do we know 'now' at night? We think we do; but we cannot. You are wondering if I am talking nonsense. Let us find out.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arun..label: On the Friar's Tapestry
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.arun..startdescription: 'If I can't prevent what's coming, I'll have to watch. I might even learn. But I've come here to learn first. If I learn enough, I won't need to watch; if I don't watch, I might not worry.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.auntm.label: On the Counterfeit Memory
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.auntm.startdescription: 'If books are the memory that does not die… where then are memories buried?' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.auntm.label: On the Midnight Twin
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.auntm.startdescription: 'Seeds grow best in darkness. Flowers grow best in sunlight. If the moon's the fruit of night, why does it always wither?' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.auntm.label: On Knot and Tangle
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.auntm.startdescription: 'Fish swim in water, roots swim in earth. What swims in blood and honey both?' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=nectar> as their <sprite name=nectar> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.azita.label: On the Second Skin
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.azita.startdescription: 'Mehrad will seek to give Abecassis his opportunity to die with honour. I will seek to prevent it. There will be other pieces on the board, no doubt, seeking to save Abecassis, or to take him as another kind of trophy. And so I must be prepared.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.azita.label: On the Forgivable Debt
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.azita.startdescription: 'It is very frustrating. I will have to knock some heads together. And Reckoners have hard heads. For once, I may have to get involved personally.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.azita.label: On the Claw and the Clouds
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.azita.startdescription: 'Mehrad sent me the Taunt that protocol requires - he is always courteous - nothing unusual in that - but he describes a shape he saw in the clouds. It troubles me.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.azita.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.azita.startdescription: 'I need to make sure the production gets all the details just right - that it's temptingest bait for my adversary…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.azita.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.azita.startdescription: 'I have no doubt at all that Zidane was murdered. But the motive confounds me. It was something to do with his work… or with the music he tried to teach it.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.azita.label: On the Threshold Revolution
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.azita.startdescription: 'They need rifles, they need boots, and they want taenite… knives, not bullets. I have no taenite knives. But I have an idea.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.azita.label: On the Absent Friend
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.azita.startdescription: 'Mehrad tells me that Medusa has begun to walk more openly in Budapest. We will both seek her out. The first to cut a scrap from her robe will win the challenge. There may be a tussle, of course. I can handle Mehrad, but Medusa is another matter.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.chaim.label: On the Second Skin
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.chaim.startdescription: 'I hope Abecassis can still be reasoned with. If not, I must be ready.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.chaim.label: On the Dappled Rose
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.chaim.startdescription: 'Deserts… they are not all so alike as the Bureau thinks. Deserts with hauntings and with curses, even less alike.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.chaim.label: On the Forgivable Debt
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.chaim.startdescription: 'One of the Reckoner lords now in Kaunas fancies himself an adept. So of course he has botched a conjuring, and of course now the conjuring has made its nest in the sewers. Always, these things take to the sewers. Always.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.chaim.label: On the Other Horizon
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.chaim.startdescription: 'I am wasting my time - it is certain. The emissaries of Ys do not pass beyond the Bounds. But I have been paid to waste my time, and so I must make absolutely certain.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.chaim.label: On the Threshold Revolution
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.chaim.startdescription: 'I like the Legion. The pay is good. But I know very little of their enemy, and I do not like to go ignorant into battle.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> as their <sprite name=edge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.chaim.label: On the Absent Friend
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.chaim.startdescription: 'An alukite is a difficult quarry - and Medusa is not like any alukite I have ever heard of. I must know how I can protect myself - or, perhaps, how I can appease her.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=edge> or Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their matching Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.conni.label: On the Messenger's Casket
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.conni.startdescription: 'The Bureau can't get involved that far East, and the locals haven't requested our help. But something smells familiar about this one. I want to be ready if it comes West.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.conni.label: On the Forgivable Debt
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.conni.startdescription: 'I have a theory about how this quarrel began… I'd like to look into it, Librarian.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.conni.label: On the Claw and the Clouds
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.conni.startdescription: 'I have witnesses from a couple of the disappearances. They say the swimmers 'saw something in the clouds.' It's pretty vague, no? But I've found that when I don't know where to start with something, where to start is here, at Hush House.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.conni.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.conni.startdescription: 'I'm worried about the audience, I'm worried about the backers, I'm very worried about the tenor, and I'm very very worried about the caterers. I know, I'm a worrier. But I don't understand enough about the work and its consequences. Help me out?' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.conni.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.conni.startdescription: 'Zidane's killer wears a human shape… but it's a renegade spirit of the lower skies. It's taken refuge in London. It won't be easy to find, but these things always have their weaknesses.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.conni.label: On the Rising While
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.conni.startdescription: 'My superior in the Bureau has secured an oracle from the Rising While. It doesn't sit right with me. And he's asked me to investigate what it means. That doesn't sit right with me either.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.conni.label: On the Friar's Tapestry
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.conni.startdescription: 'Idiot adepts rushing up north to try some half-digested Killasimi rite they've got out of a pack of fungus-wizards. Whatever happens, I won't like it. So I'm here to look into countermeasures.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.coqui.label: On the Messenger's Casket
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.coqui.startdescription: 'I have rather a knack for getting into things - I just need to see if any of this has been tried before -' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> as their <sprite name=knock> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.coqui.label: On the Oriflamme Heist
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.coqui.startdescription: 'But if it might turn out that it were true, well, a girl might find herself curious about exactly how the thing might have been carried off…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> as their <sprite name=knock> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.coqui.label: On the Endless Guest
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.coqui.startdescription: 'The local Duties have it in a box. So we know where the things are. But what interests me, darling, is where they came from. I didn't think there was anything at all like that in Kraków - not since the War anyhow.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.coqui.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.coqui.startdescription: 'It's certain to be quite the most crushing bore, but if I happen to go, I have some rather vivid ideas for my look. I just need to, you know, flesh them out.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.coqui.label: On the 'Invisible Opera'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.coqui.startdescription: 'My family-of-the-moment are total sweethearts, of course they are, but I am just the tiniest bit restless… and, well, if anyone in Venice might find themselves suddenly down a daughter, I'd like to have done my research.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.coqui.label: On the Threshold Revolution
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.coqui.startdescription: 'There is an officer in the Legion - a very special friend of mine. I want him to have something to remember me by. But he also has very special tastes.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.corso.label: On the Particular Mystique
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.corso.startdescription: 'Lot of Dawn iconography around these new cults. Some of them have a little pash for figures like Sunset Celia, who you might know is, hm, theologically interesting. Archbishop's paid me to look into the origins of the Celian Prayer, see if anything embarrassing might come up.' [Try a book with as much Mystery:  <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.corso.label: On the Unfettered Eye
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.corso.startdescription: 'They need me to authenticate a manuscript. Mystic illustrations of the 'Unfettered Eye'. I need to do some cross-checking. ' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.corso.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.corso.startdescription: 'Someone is going, but he's not really an opera aficionado either, more interested in, eh, catering. He's bringing a recipe book with him. Sort of a recipe book. Carapace savour-arts. I've been asked to acquire it, but I'm no good with Carapace languages. So here I am, ready to read up on... stains.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.corso.label: On the 'Invisible Opera'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.corso.startdescription: 'I'd probably be safe if I sit at the back. Only probably. So I'm going to sub-contract to someone braver. I have someone in mind: someone brave, perceptive, but unfortunately, not stupid. They're expecting a very special bribe. So here I am looking for inspiration.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.corso.label: On the Royal Endeavour
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.corso.startdescription: 'I'm not a spy. Spies don't go to libraries. Just a paid researcher. Doing my bit for world peace. Mind if I take a look around?' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.corso.label: On the Threshold Revolution
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.corso.startdescription: 'I can still get to my Hattington, but I'll need bribes. And the lady I need to bribe - well, she has plenty of money, but she's, let's say, a gourmet…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]
